metadata.description: Claude Code integrations for the falsable tools. Each plugin lives in its product's repo; this file only lists them.

plugins.name: a2dlc
plugins.description: The a2dlc gate as PreToolUse and Stop hooks, active only in repos that installed a2dlc.

plugins.name: chronosgraph
plugins.description: The ChronosGraph code-intelligence MCP server of a running ChronosGraph stack.

plugins.name: entropos
plugins.description: The Entropos MCP tools of a running Entropos server. Routing Claude Code's own traffic through Entropos stays a user setting (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL).
